method: actual object part polygons, 128-point ellipse for round parts; Euler rotation for boxes; mesh face projection union; chairs checked as 4 separate physical instances
limits: 不同组的平面投影相交与实体硬相交分开报告，避免把允许的上下错层误称穿模。
同组零件装配/花卉自身重叠不作为组间碰撞。
边界采用源图设计面；仅坡道允许落在原中踏步及南廊衔接内。
本项未认证结构荷载、护栏安全、可攀爬性或柜门动态开启净空。
approachMethod: reachable canStep grid point 0.23..0.85m outside actual group projection; ramp also permits reachable on-deck point
